name: incidents
description: An app's incidents, remembered: record each error with how it was fixed, and ask what a new one is, who fixed it last time, and the fix that worked

record.description: Record an incident and, when known, the fix that resolved it (its outcome)

query.description: What the precedents say about an incident: the leading fix, its confidence, and the precedents it stands on

facts.description: The closest past incidents, best first, each cut to what the caller may see

probabilities.description: P(fix | incident) over the nearest precedents

decide.description: The fix for an incident from precedent, with the nearest precedent's cause, owner and runbook when the caller may see them; with no precedent close enough, asks how it was fixed and records it

start.description: How many incidents the model holds
